body: Probably should be "more than one Unicode [code point](https://unicode.org/glossary/#code_point)".

This looks like it could crash if used on the first line.
If it is on the first line at column 0, it should return 0.
I think this should return the last line's length if it is at the last line.

Maybe these should accept a line and a column instead of a caret, I think it would be more useful if you didn't need to have a caret where you want to check.
You could then do `get_next_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())` for this functionality.
